item.title: LIA hosts intimate dinner for top creatives in Baan Phraya at Mandarin Oriental in Bangkok
item.description: It was an evening of free-flowing conversation, food and drinks by the river in Bangkok on Sunday, 22 March. LIA hosted its annual soirée following AdFest, bringing together some of the jurors and top creatives from Thailand and across the region. More than 30 people attended the special evening.

item.title: Countdown to New York Festivals Advertising Awards 2026 Entry Deadline: Thursday, April 23
item.description: There's just one month to go until entries close for the New York Festivals Advertising Awards, with the 2026 show inviting creatives, agencies and brands worldwide to submit work that demonstrates bold ideas, measurable impact and creative effectiveness.

item.title: First-time delegate Bruce Tweedie finds warmth, wisdom and energy at AdFest
